title: Nest Tool Options Into The Tool Tree
description: Nest utility-scoped window measures inside the tool ribbon (not a separate rail), migrate tool-specific options out of general Window Options across playground apps, and make puzzle distribution groups true probability trees whose sliders always sum to 1.
summary:
Nested utility-scoped window measures inside the tool ribbon and migrated tool-specific options out of general Window Options across playground apps.

## Framework
- `UtilityTree` accepts `utilityOptions` and renders them as an extra ribbon row when `direction` is `up`; hardcoded `SelectionUtilityOptions` only when plugin measures are absent.
- `utilityBarNode` threads partitioned utility options into the toolbar; window chrome no longer passes a separate `utilityOptions` prop to `Window`.
- Removed the detached `window-utility-options` stack from `Window`.
- WGPU `render_window_utility_options_rail` renders a compact strip above the footer (no detached "Utility Options" header card).
- Added `UtilityTree` utilityOptions ribbon test (framework-renderer-react: 180/180 pass).

## Puzzle (2D/3D/5D)
- Brush utility options now include suggestion offset, overlap, distribution trees, and optional placement picker — all tagged `active_utility_id: Some("brush")`.
- Fill utility options unchanged (count/mode/voxels).
- Added `uniform` + `normalize_kind_weight_group` + `ensure_catalog_kind_weights` per dimension; weight handlers renormalize siblings so each distribution group sums to 1.
- Distribution group labels show total percentage; nested kind sliders remain collapsible trees.
- Added `kind_weight_group_normalizes_to_sum_one` test (2D).

## Other apps
- **Lowpoly**: selection kind + method moved to utility options tagged for default transform utility (`move`).
- **Note**: pencil width and eraser radius split into per-utility option groups (`pencil`, `eraserStroke`, `eraserPoint`).
- **Raster**: added `window_measures` with brush/eraser size+opacity utility option groups; handlers accept slider `value` payloads.
